SchemaHashStabilityTests.testRequestAndResultSchemaHashesAreStableAcrossBuilds: the hashes describe reports must equal the frozen values; a drifted schema changes the hash and fails.
SchemaHashStabilityTests.testExactlyThirtyFiveOperationsInAllowlistOrder: exactly 35 operations in commands.md order; an added, dropped or reordered command fails.
